proves.claim: A census prints the seconds to its first job, through pass 1 and in its reruns, adding up to its wall clock.

cli.io-test-census-phases.a-census-of-40.why: Without it, a slow census phase could not be named from the summary.

proves.claim: The reruns phase is the time from the end of pass 1 to the last rerun.

cli.io-test-census-phases.the-reruns-pha.why: Without it, rerun time would be lost inside the census wall clock.
